why: B's (9.11) part follows from A (A_to_B_9_11, rt_check OK, uses the hypothesis). B's (B, n, o) become project OrientedBranchingStructures; the dimensions come from the orientations, via the glue lemma isSubmanifoldOfDim_of_orientation. At smooth y ∈ U ∩ U' both represent T y, so eq_9_11 gives equal degree-ℓ parts. At non-smooth y no sheet passes, since Mᵢ ⊆ supp Θ ⊆ X_∞. B's Proposition 9.3.9 does not follow. The project's proposition_9_3_9 is stated for an abstract bd : OrTangent → OrTangent, a function of the oriented tangent space T_y(Mᵢ, oᵢ). B's T_y(∂Mᵢ, o_∂Mᵢ) (bdOrB) is built from the sheet itself: the set T_y∂Mᵢ and the outward vectors of Mᵢ. Deriving B from (9.11) needs T_y(Mᵢ,oᵢ) = T_y(M'ⱼ,o'ⱼ) with d = 1 to imply bdOrB oᵢ y = bdOrB o'ⱼ y, i.e. that T_y∂M = T^R_yM and the outward half-space depend only on T_yM for tame M. The project lists exactly this as not formalized (partial cones of submanifolds). It is a genuine gap in A (substantial mathematics), not glue. B_to_A cannot use B, which assumes X.PObj tame and an orientation T; A's four conjuncts assume neither and hold for any bd. It re-proves them outright, as copies of the project's proofs (from the unbanned subDegIndex_eq_of_submanifoldTangent_eq). Universes at 0.
